Ethan Diallo
ethan.diallo@example.com | Boston, MA
Ethan Diallo has 9 years of experience in design. Most recently, Staff Product
Designer at Brackenridge Agency (2023-2026), where they designed and prototyped
features in Figma used by 26+ engineers to build against. Before that, Senior
Product Designer at Bellwood Agency (2017-2023). Education: B.S. Graphic
Design, Cal Poly, 2016. Core skills: Adobe XD, Wireframing, UX research, Design
systems, Prototyping.
